subject: mathematics
concept: Fractions of a group, not just a shape (e.g. 1/4 of 8 objects)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts a group of on-screen objects into equal groups to find a fraction of the set
exercise.pictorial: Student circles 1/4 of a pictured group of items
exercise.abstract: Student calculates a unit fraction of a small whole number set

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
